Sample Timing:
Samples were collected at 1) D-10, 2) D-4, and 3) every 4 days until D+60 (or hospital discharge).
Samples were grouped into the following timepoints 1) Baseline (Prior to conditioning); 2) Pre-HSCT (D-4 to D0); 3) Engraftment (D+4 to D+28); and 4) Late Post-HSCT (after D+28)
Intestinal Domination Dynamics:
The prevalence of intestinal domination by a certain bacterial genus was about 80% of all patients before the start of conditioning.
The incidence of intestinal domination increased to approximately 95% of all patients during the engraftment period and then began to decrease.
2 patients (2.0%) already had Enterococcus domination prior to allo-HSCT
